periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: The primary axis of the teardrop-shaped patches is oriented at approximately 70 degrees relative to the horizontal, converging toward the midline at the top.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval/teardrop shape with a height-to-width ratio of approximately 2:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Significant downward tapering, with the inferior margin extending substantially further from the geometric center than the superior margin.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide lateral separation, with the gap between the ears approximately equal to 1.5 times the width of a single ear.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Convex, semi-circular curvature with a soft, slightly irregular outline due to fur tufts at the top.
